'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jason Foss LS Naboo: Battle Plains''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jason Foss]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
